candidate.user_input: When does a Navan hotel stay require submitting an expense report, and how are business incidentals handled?
candidate.reference: If you do not incur any additional hotel charges, there will be no need to submit an expense report for your stay. Incidental expenses that are business-related and within policy still are required to be submitted through an expense report.

evidence.quote: If you do not incur any additional hotel charges, there will be no need to submit an expense report for your stay. Incidental expenses that are business-related and within policy still are required to be submitted through an expense report.
evidence.contribution: This explains when an expense report is needed for Navan hotel stays and how business incidentals are handled.

candidate.connection: The quote directly states the conditions for submitting an expense report for Navan hotel stays and business incidentals.

source_conditions: Hotel room charges and applicable taxes for Navan bookings are paid directly by GitLab via a central virtual card.
If no additional hotel charges are incurred, no expense report is needed for the stay.
A personal credit card must be provided at check-in for potential charges such as room service, parking, minibar, or other extras.
Business-related incidental expenses within policy must be submitted through an expense report.
